thread:
oncall-bot: PAGER — P1: routing anomalies detected for dedicated pool 'dp-west-2-4' — increased 5xx rate + latency spike. alert: router.fallback.loop.detected. link: https://redwood.inc/ops/alerts/1719273456
ashley: I'm on it. seeing a sharp drop in healthy hosts reported by autoscaler for that pool.
mike: can you dump the router variant mapping? curious if we started sending traffic to an incompatible variant.
ashley: pulling mapping now.
ashley: ````
# router shard mapping (trimmed)
route: /v1/generate
preferred_variant: rdx-7b-q4
fallback_policy:
  - region: eu-west-1
  - variant: rdx-7b-8bit
  - action: failover
````
jordan: wait — fallback policy looks normal. but autoscaler reports pool size 0 for dp-west-2-4 at 1719273420. that would cause router to fallback to eu-west-1.
ashley: Exactly. But eu-west-1 has capacity and is a different variant build (rdx-7b-8bit) which isn't compatible with live KV cache layout for some in-flight sessions. that mismatch shows up as OOM/5xx.
sam: Any customer-facing impact yet? support flagged an enterprise customer reporting 90% errors.
lei: Yep, hops for that customer go to dp-west-2-4; if some requests get trapped in the fallback loop they either error or timeout. Win rate down to ~40% for that app.
ashley: I'm reattaching autoscaler logs. ````
[autoscaler] pool dp-west-2-4 scale_to=0 reason=signal_delta threshold=0.12 metric=healthy_ratio observed=0.05
[pool] heartbeat lost from host gpu-24 at 1719273398
````
mike: Why did healthy_ratio drop? is it probe flapping or metric misread from proxy?
jordan: quick check: svc-proxy in that pool started returning 200s for health, but the telemetry aggregator mis-tagged them as 'standby' due to a label race. aggregator code had a recent change rolling out this week.
sam: So autoscaler saw 'standby' and thought hosts unhealthy -> scale_to 0 -> router fails over -> fallback variant mismatch -> 5xx. cascade.
ashley: Mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler for dp-west-2-4 (prevent further scale downs), 2) force router to prefer local pool override, 3) roll back aggregator label change. Doing step 1 now.
ashley: @sre-automation-bot run: autoscaler pause --pool dp-west-2-4 --by=manual --reason="pager hit"
sre-automation-bot: Confirmed: autoscaler pause applied to dp-west-2-4 by ashley.
mike: Routing override: adding temporary routing rule to prefer pool id instead of health tag. command: ````
routectl set-priority /v1/generate pool=dp-west-2-4 ttl=15m --force
````
mike: Applied. watch for traffic shift back.
ashley: Rolling back aggregator label change in staging and promoting hotfix to prod. patch: revert pr #3245. I'm running the rollback now.
lei: Customer impact update: Affected customers: acct-987 (enterprise), acct-412 (mid-market). Errors started ~1719273400, peaked at 1719273500. Noting SLO blips for both.
jordan: logs show error class: VariantKVMismatch -> 502 from runtime when session expects KV format v2.1 and backend is v2.0.
sam: Any risk in scaling pool back up quickly? will warmup cause heavier costs but reduce errors.
ashley: I've queued scale-up to min=2 for dp-west-2-4 to rehydrate hosts: ````
autoscaler set-min dp-west-2-4 2 --by=manual --reason="hotfix and rollback"
````
sre-automation-bot: Action accepted. scaling request queued. Estimated readiness ~5m.
mike: Seeing initial traffic move back to dp-west-2-4. 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 3% in last 2m. latency normalizing.
lei: Sent note to support with preliminary RCA and ETA. support will notify the two impacted customers.
jordan: rolling rollback completed across aggregator fleet. telemetry tag is now 'active' as expected.
ashley: autoscaler still paused. We'll keep paused until we validate aggregator fix in canary for 30m and then unpause.
sam: Handing off to night oncall: @mike please follow for 45m. escalate to eng-sre if errors >5% or additional customer reports.
mike: ack. I'll keep an eye on SLAs and promote a postmortem doc with timeline.
ashley: quick postmortem notes we should collect: autoscaler decision logic (thresholds), aggregator rollout PR details, routing fallback TTLs, session KV-version detection, impacted customers & SLO hits.
lei: I'll draft the initial incident timeline and share in #incidents.
ashley: Thanks team. marking incident as mitigated for now, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
